Audi Sport Team Phoenix: Ernst Moser's team from Meuspath next to the Nürburgring. Audi works team in the DTM since 2006.
BMW Team RBM: Bart Mampaey's Belgian team, a BMW works entrant since the marque's DTM return in 2012.
BMW Team Schnitzer: Schnitzer Motorsport of Freilassing, BMW's partner since the 1960s. Bruno Spengler won the 2012 title on BMW's return.
STIHL AMG-Mercedes: One of the two HWA AG entries from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the AMG-Mercedes DTM cars.
Euronics AMG-Mercedes: HWA AG's second entry, run as EURONICS/Thomas Sabo AMG-Mercedes. Gary Paffett was the 2005 champion.
Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten, Audi's lead DTM squad since 2000.
BMW Team MTEK: Ernest Knoors' Dutch team, new to the DTM in 2013 with ex-F1 driver Timo Glock and rookie Marco Wittmann.
Audi Sport Team Abt: Abt Sportsline's second Audi entry, with double champion Timo Scheider and rookie Adrien Tambay.
stern AMG-Mercedes: Peter Mücke's Berlin team, running two F3 graduates for Mercedes in 2013.
Audi Sport Team Rosberg: Keke Rosberg's team, in the DTM since 1995 and with Audi since 2006.
BMW Team RMG: Stefan Reinhold's team from Andernach, a BMW works entrant since 2012. Martin Tomczyk was the 2011 champion.
